comment.zh-TW: 花蓮機場未來 5 天停飛風險為中，主因是濃霧／低雲。由於僅美國模式提供能見度，在 10/30 08 時–10/31 02 時、10/31 08 時–11/1 02 時、11/1 08–20 時與 11/2 08 時–11/4 02 時預估能見度介於 39 至 653 公尺，1 個模式中 1 個認為中以上而判定為中。強風與降雨風險皆為低，歐洲模式最高陣風僅 17.1 節，日本模式最大 6 小時雨量為 10.2 毫米。

comment.en: The main driver for Nha Trang over the next five days is heavy rain/thunderstorms: the airport forecast (TAF) calls for heavy thunderstorms on 10/30 01:00–07:00 and 10/30 19:00–10/31 01:00, with visibility down to 2000 m and 2500 m respectively. The rule light therefore rates these two periods Medium, and all other periods Low. However, in every period the model vote shows no category where more than half the models say Medium or above, 6-hour rain peaks at only 5.7 mm, and the chance of over 50 mm of rain in 24 hours is at most 2%. The airport forecast has a mean wind of 7 kt and crosswind of 5.3 kt, so wind is not a threat, and the overall disruption risk is rated Medium.

en.text: The main driver for Nha Trang over the next five days is heavy rain/thunderstorms: the airport forecast (TAF) calls for heavy thunderstorms on 10/30 01:00–07:00 and 10/30 19:00–10/31 01:00, with visibility down to 2000 m and 2500 m respectively.
The rule light therefore rates these two periods Medium, and all other periods Low.

However, in every period the model vote shows no category where more than half the models say Medium or above, 6-hour rain peaks at only 5.7 mm, and the chance of over 50 mm of rain in 24 hours is at most 2%.
The airport forecast has a mean wind of 7 kt and crosswind of 5.3 kt, so wind is not a threat, and the overall disruption risk is rated Medium.
